answer.thought: The market has served its purpose; I have eaten and the air is cooling. I intended to go to Lodhi Gardens earlier, but the delay has served me well, for the heat that would have made the walk a punishment is now a pleasant breeze. I will leave the noise of civil society behind and walk among the tombs, where the stillness might allow the mind to settle before the evening darkens completely.
